entry.title: Hoja Half Corona
entry.summaryHtml: Smooth, mild-to-medium Nicaraguan tobacco in a very compact 3.5″ × 50 format. Australian smokers discussing the Hoja line describe it as starting mild and smooth, then building toward medium, with positive comments on construction, draw and value. The short, broad format makes it a compact handmade option rather than a narrow cigarillo-style smoke.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the exact Half Corona at A$21 for a single and A$189 for a bundle of 10. The single is used as the catalogue benchmark. Public line-specific tasting detail is sparse, so the flavour ceiling is kept conservative rather than inventing complexity that has not been documented.
